addition.item: Added full Joomla 6 native DevArt Slider component with modern MVC architecture
Added frontend DevArt Slider module integration
Added frontend file-based cache rendering system
Added theme presets including red, blue, green, yellow, dark and light
Added dashboard statistics and production recommendations
Added GitHub-based Joomla update server support

change.item: Slider architecture designed specifically for Joomla 6 and PHP 8.2+
Frontend rendering optimized for high-traffic editorial environments
Template rendering isolated with dedicated renderer architecture
CSS and JavaScript namespaced for safe third-party template compatibility
Mobile template behavior optimized for responsive frontend rendering
Video rendering integrated with lightweight frontend controls
Cache-first architecture implemented to reduce database load
Cloudflare and CDN-friendly frontend rendering strategy used throughout
Production-safe frontend rendering with controlled query limits
Modern Joomla service provider and MVCComponent architecture used throughout

security.item: Added SQL injection protection using Joomla database APIs and parameterized queries
Added XSS protection through proper output escaping
Added CSRF protection for administrator actions
Added ACL enforcement for administrator operations
Added protected cache directory structure with index.html isolation
Added strict input validation for slider configuration values

note.item: Initial public production release of DevArt Slider for Joomla 6
Designed for editorial, magazine, news and high-traffic Joomla websites
Built for Joomla 6 only with PHP 8.2+
Always test on a staging environment before production deployment
